pages.text: The dimensional extractor contains a $(#AA00AA)Djinni$() that quickly collects$(br)  resources generated by dimensional machines or worker spirits$(br)  and transfers the results to an inventory below.$(br)

pages.title: Using
pages.text: It's very simple to use: just place your machines/spirits on top of it$(br)  and connect an inventory directly below that accepts items from the top side.$(br2)  NOTE: If the inventory is full, the djinn will simply discard the $()
